Class AppSettingsController

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.ApiController
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.AppSettingsController
@RequestMapping("/api/admin/settings") @RestController public class AppSettingsController extends ApiController
The four admin-maintained name lists behind the TA and ULA application forms: the majors and the topics an applicant may pick from.

Each list is its own table with a single string column that is also the key, so the four are served by one controller keyed on the list path segment rather than four copies of the same CRUD code. Renaming is a delete plus an insert, since the name is the key.
